checkpoint_scope: Task 1 opened the portfolio; Tasks 5 through 9 now record artifact-backed attacks on the probability, ELBO, local-observation, gauge, Gaussian, information-geometric, source, interpretive-scope, exact-action, contraction, Dobrushin, operator-spectrum, product-reference, finite-interaction, nonlinear-derivative, projection-residual, score-tangent, Hermite-spectral, generalized-mode, cocycle, beta-function, fixed-object, and attribution-scope interfaces without asserting terminal release.

attacks.attack: Attempted to break the repaired claims with uncountable moving atoms, nonmeasurable RN selections, the false assertion that one generating partition sequence is cofinal, an invalid infinite-measure complement step, singular recognition laws, infinite-entropy cancellation, diagonal infinite total correlation, unsafe extended arithmetic, infinite-KL equality without recovery, and exceptional-point RCP rebinding.
attacks.response: The repaired claims survive because common domination is an exact iff atomic-support criterion, kernel densities use a finite joint partition-limit version, kernel KL uses the common-dominator perspective martingale plus Fatou and log-sum bounds, fixed sigma-finite integration localizes to finite-measure pieces, the ELBO is defined from finite log evidence minus extended KL, recovery remains finite-KL only, and the coarse RCP is declared pointwise as the pushforward of the fixed fine version.

attacks.attack: Attempted to leave the context argument untyped, select baseline conditionals independently at exceptional outside states, infer evidence ascent from one block update, sum overlapping local objectives as independent global factors, and drop dependence terms when only attention-label row marginals are specified.
attacks.response: The repaired theorem starts from context-indexed normalized baseline and record kernels with family-level jointly measurable densities, fixes one measurable baseline RCP version, restricts joint-law invariance to the posterior-outside almost-everywhere class, uses the posterior-full regular set and conditional KL chain, compares only finite posterior-KL laws with one outside marginal, counts each actual record once globally, and retains conditional total correlation.

attacks.attack: Attempted to erase the conditioning sigma-algebra by renaming observations as agents and used an exact binary extra-record model: equal label priors and zero source energies, but P(R=1|J=0)=1/4 and P(R=1|J=1)=3/4, so the energy-only row is (1/2,1/2) while the true posterior is (1/4,3/4).
attacks.response: The observation theorem proves only normalized kernel randomization and preserves conditioning. The attention theorem now assumes the complete selected-record likelihood has a label-independent residual and no other record or factor reads any label; the binary witness violates exactly H-ATTENTION-LABEL and proves that premise necessary.

attacks.attack: Attacked reciprocal old/new conventions, Hom-bundle conversion, mixed-reference determinant scope, closure of the fixed-datum link family, and equality of the active gauge image with the full pointwise diagonal. The disconnected-group witness showed the last equality false without evaluation surjectivity.
attacks.response: The repaired source fixes one old-to-new convention, converts cross maps before applying Hom-bundle gluing, makes measure pushforward primary, confines determinants to Lebesgue or declared relative-invariance tiers, proves shared-link nonclosure by explicit GL(2,R) matrices, and states only containment of the active image unless evaluation surjectivity is proved.

attacks.attack: Attacked strict positivity with the zero-self consensus mode, inserted the assembled NK precision into one K-dimensional edge KL, distinguished coordinate restriction from tangent quotient, tested full-rank nonorthonormal aggregation, and recomputed Haar closure, quotient determinants, and the exact epsilon-regularized KL.
attacks.response: The exact componentwise kernel replaces blanket positivity, typed K-by-K edge precisions replace the invalid edge formula, the quotient is explicitly pointwise and has Schur complement Lambda, aggregation is obtained by congruence, and Haar averaging occurs only over an assumed compact closure. Symbolic residuals vanish and deterministic stress remains below the recorded tolerances, but derivations supply closure.

attacks.attack: Compared Campbell's theorem to one-scale uniqueness, challenged eliminative readings of Esfeld-Lam and van Fraassen, enforced the Chapter 12 ban on interpretive ESTABLISHED tags, and exposed an uncontrolled and logically overstrong operational-holonomy criterion.
attacks.response: Campbell is mapped to the cross-dimensional two-function family and simplex restriction; the philosophy positions are chapter-local DEFINITIONs at checked source scope; the stale averaged-connection credit is removed; and the holonomy route is OPEN with a controlled pairwise witness and a stronger sufficient factorization formulation.

attacks.attack: Reconstructed the construction without the manuscript proof and attacked unbounded-Lp exponentials, hidden normalization constants, a nonsaturated quotient domain, incompatible Dobrushin laws, one-step strictness, necessity of the accumulated coefficient bound, exceptional reverse-kernel versions, and downstream fixed-point typing.
attacks.response: The repaired construction makes the RN action global on bounded functions but analytic only on a declared open L-infinity ball, separates mass-tracking from probability-normalized actions and their derivatives, descends through a saturated additive-constant quotient, states reverse-kernel identities almost everywhere for fixed inputs, proves the exact conditional-variance defect, and gives compatible finite witnesses showing both nonnecessity and failure of one-step strictness.

attacks.attack: Tested essential rather than pointwise Dobrushin coefficients, the all-compacts Calkin convention, positivity of the dual eigenfunctional, Banach-lattice hypotheses, invariance of the circle kernel, the alpha-one endpoint, and the attempted use of the standard Holder norm as a lattice norm.
attacks.response: The source now uses essential row distance, an explicit all-compacts Calkin quotient and pole-plus-positive-dual hypotheses, an invariant inverse-branch circle kernel, complex periodic C-alpha spaces with alpha one identified as Lipschitz, and a separate Banach-space circle witness rather than misclassifying the Holder norm as a Banach-lattice norm.

attacks.attack: Used diagonal cloning to destroy equivalence to every product target, a diagonal-law representative to break nonproduct coordinate averaging, and a Haar-preserving torus shear to mix singleton and pair Hoeffding degree. The first source also lacked the Markov/Radon-Nikodym square needed to lift coordinate covariance to the nonlinear action.
attacks.response: The repaired theorem makes product equivalence a separate per-scale admission premise, uses a genuine product law for Fubini-defined coordinate expectations, declares componentwise/permutation realization only as a sufficient grading-intertwining hypothesis, and proves nonlinear covariance directly from pushed measure pairs and an equivariant kernel before differentiating or projecting.

attacks.attack: Replaced the nonlinear log-Laplace map by a fixed conditional expectation away from zero, challenged the derivative outside the origin-centered chart, deleted the top-order interaction, and attempted to call a bounded projected image exact without an invariance proof or residual.
attacks.response: Full Boolean-lattice extraction and assembly retain every subset interaction with the sharp finite-size bound; bounded recentering proves local analyticity and the tilted derivative at every bounded interaction; and the coordinate and quotient residuals obey exact inverse identities, two-sided norm bounds, and a zero-if-and-only-if exact-image-invariance theorem.

attacks.attack: Attempted to confine the quadratic-mean tangent to bounded scores, to drop the centering requirement, to omit the sign-change tail of the squared-linear path, to replace the extensive replication by an arithmetic mean, to identify the bounded action quotient with the whole centered L2 space, and to read Fisher equality at one parameter as recovery of the experiment.
attacks.response: Centering is forced by the exact square-root identity rather than assumed; the tail is controlled by dominated convergence on the set where the linear factor changes sign, and the normalizer term is exactly O(t^2); the replication norm is computed to be exactly sqrt(b) so an arithmetic mean would change Fisher information by b^2; the bounded quotient is dense but proper with the unbounded Gaussian score as witness, so only its Fisher completion is L2_0; and the independent Bernoulli witness separates Fisher equality from sufficiency.

attacks.attack: Attempted to correlate the block coordinates while keeping the eigenvalues, to keep the uncorrelated normalization under correlation, to assert simple eigenvalues in the multivariate case, to describe the scalar Hermite modes as general linear-group irreducibles, to place the spectrum on the bounded action chart, to claim zero is an eigenvalue, and to promote the linearization to nonlinear convergence.
attacks.response: The correlated eigenvalues are computed exactly and differ for every nonzero correlation, while the uncorrelated normalization destroys the fixed output law and with it the endomorphism property; multivariate degree multiplicities are binomial and a general linear action changes the reference covariance; the Hermite polynomials are unbounded so the spectrum lives on the L2 tangent and the exact exponential-action domain is classified in four cases; the operator is injective with dense proper range, so zero is in the continuous spectrum and not an eigenvalue; and the nonlinear obligation is recorded as open, in agreement with the cited source's own scope statement.

attacks.attack: Attempted to write an ordinary eigenvalue equation across unequal scale spaces, to reverse or unorder the derivative product, to call a two-parameter family a one-parameter semigroup, to report an exponent with only tempered scalar mode normalization, and to invoke a multiplicative ergodic decomposition for a deterministic blocking sequence.
attacks.response: The mode equation is typed as a compatible line between adjacent fibers and the one-dimensional-to-two-dimensional witness shows the eigen-equation is ill typed; the chain-rule induction fixes the order and the unipotent pair shows the product does not commute; the semigroup reduction is gated on stationary identified maps with periodicity giving monodromy; the exponent theorem requires two-sided tempered trivializations and the exp(k^2) witness shows scalar tempering alone fails; and the Oseledets route is declined in the source with its full hypothesis list named.

attacks.attack: Attempted to subtract across unequal interaction spaces, to reuse the retained-projection symbol for the pulled map, to report a retained beta as exact on the strength of idempotence, to treat the beta as comparison independent, to hold the reference fixed while changing it, to read a discrete sequence as determining a continuous beta, to reuse a contextual principal connection as the scale derivative, and to transfer fixedness between tiers.
attacks.response: The subtraction is formed only after the declared comparison isomorphism, with a cross-fiber witness showing why; the pulled map is given its own symbol and the retained projection keeps its own; exactness is proved equivalent to exact-image invariance and the projected witness exhibits a false fixed line; the moving-frame witness shows even an identity native step has a nonzero beta; the reference change is derived to obey an inhomogeneous law whose extra term is the beta of the reference increment; the sine-interpolation pair shows discrete endpoints underdetermine the continuous beta; the scale connection is typed on a different base from the contextual connections; and five finite witnesses block every tier transfer, with a sixth separating monodromy from one-step fixedness.

attacks.attack: Attempted to attribute the arbitrary-integer theorem, the exact operator spectrum, and nonlinear global attraction to the cited renormalization-and-probability paper; to reuse the local vault note's stable-manifold phrasing as authority; to cite equation numbers that could not be opened in this environment; to apply a finite-state lumpability theorem to a standard-Borel partition; and to present the discrete projection-memory recurrence as an imported identity.
attacks.response: Metadata was verified directly against the arXiv abstract record and the attribution was narrowed to four items at section granularity, with everything else proved in the manuscript and explicitly non-attributed; the vault note's stronger phrasing is recorded as exceeding the primary scope and is not used; equation-level anchors are recorded with their provenance and their limitation instead of being asserted; the standard-Borel lumpability biconditional is proved with a Borel-section hypothesis, a uniqueness clause, and a weak-lumpability witness, with the monograph cited only at chapter granularity; and the discrete recurrence and its autonomy biconditional are proved, with the historical sources cited only as the continuous-time antecedent.

independent_reconstruction.method: Two oracle-separated reconstructors rebuilt the Task 8 interaction interfaces from the frozen types rather than the manuscript proof. For Task 9, three mechanism-separated routes were developed without contact: a score and quadratic-mean route, a Gaussian and Hermite spectral route, and a cocycle, beta, and fixed-object route, each hash-binding its input bytes at the start. The integrator then wrote the released proofs against the frozen contract rather than importing any route verbatim, and the referenced artifact binds all four prior and current reconstruction memos by digest.
independent_reconstruction.conclusion: After the Task 8 product, representative, derivative-domain, gauge-square, and projection-scope repairs, and after the Task 9 typing, tempering, residual, and attribution repairs, the reconstructions agree with all twelve bound claims. The three Task 9 routes converge only on two type separations and derive them disjointly, so that agreement is treated as convergence of discipline rather than corroboration. This is checkpoint evidence only and does not assert terminal release; the run-level oracle erasure remains scheduled.

oracle_erasure.method: Scheduled before terminal release; remove the search preference, scan direct and paraphrased dependence, and recompute the full target closure. A scoped check over the Task 9 claims alone is recorded in section 8 of evidence/task-9-integrated-proof.md; it found no direct or paraphrased dependence on the affirmative prior in those statements, assumptions, or proofs, but it does not cover the target closure and does not discharge this gate.
oracle_erasure.conclusion: No terminal release is attempted at this checkpoint, and the scoped Task 9 check is not treated as the run-level erasure.
